races.name: Donohue Marquees Risk Of Thunder Chase
races.verdict:
STUMPTOWN is a very smart performer in cross-country events, winning 5 times including this race, at the Cheltenham Festival and the historic Velka Pardubicka, and he looks to hold strong claims after reappearing with a victory over hurdles. The biggest threat could come from Fountain House, while The Goffer is also considered.

  1. STUMPTOWN (IRE)
  2. FOUNTAIN HOUSE (IRE)
  3. THE GOFFER (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
THEFLYINGKING may have his quirks but sets the standard and should be well up to winning a race of this nature. Bumper winner Sparkling Wit is bred to be at least smart over jumps and entitled to be in the mix, with Border Lad, Ravendark and Sine Qua Non others to consider.

  1. THEFLYINGKING (IRE)
  2. SPARKLING WIT (IRE)
  3. BORDER LAD (IRE)

races.name: Pertemps Network Group Handicap Hurdle (Qualifier)
races.verdict:
A very competitive renewal and it could be worth taking a chance on HGRANCA DE THAIX, who looks well treated on the pick of last season's form. Buachaillbocht is capable fresh and heads the dangers along with J'Arrive de L'Est, who could still have more to offer for the Emmet Mullins yard.

  1. HGRANCA DE THAIX (FR)
  2. BUACHAILLBOCHT
  3. J'ARRIVE DE L'EST (FR)

races.name: Colm Quinn BMW Novice Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A cleaner round of jumping can see unexposed GOMEZ ADDAMS make it 2 wins from 3 starts over hurdles. Crystabel may be the main danger if allowed to dictate, while there could be more to come from Bunker Buster if putting it all together.

  1. GOMEZ ADDAMS (IRE)
  2. CRYSTABEL (IRE)
  3. BUNKER BUSTER (IRE)

races.name: Frontline Security Grabel Mares Hurdle (Listed)
races.verdict:
A listed mares hurdle in which OLDSCHOOL OUTLAW looks the most solid option on the pick of her form last season. Savante heads the list of dangers from Alliteration.

  1. OLDSCHOOL OUTLAW (IRE)
  2. SAVANTE (IRE)
  3. ALLITERATION (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Craddockstown Novice Chase (Grade 2)
races.verdict:
LOVELY HURLING has made a promising start over fences, closing all the way to the line when runner-up in a Grade 3 novice at Navan in February, and he could be ready to go one better on his return. Stablemate Zanoosh appeals as a noteworthy recruit to chasing and is feared most, ahead of Kainsbourg.

  1. LOVELY HURLING (IRE)
  2. ZANOOSH (IRE)
  3. KAINSBOURG (FR)

races.name: John Durkan Memorial Punchestown Chase (Grade 1)
races.verdict:
Willie Mullins has dominated this race in recent times and GAELIC WARRIOR is taken to land the prize for the second year in succession. After impressive wins at both Cheltenham and this course in the spring, he can pick up where he left off to confirm the placings with Fact To File from last year's renewal, with Final Demand completing the shortlist.

  1. GAELIC WARRIOR (GER)
  2. FACT TO FILE (FR)
  3. FINAL DEMAND (IRE)

races.name: Keadeen Hotel (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
CEASAR'S BALL looks another interesting type for powerful connections, and he's taken to follow up his point win on Rules debut. Water Mill is an intriguing danger switched to a bumper, with Night Chaperone the pick of those with experience. Martin Brassil's newcomer Doyouhearmenow completes the shortlist.

  1. CEASAR'S BALL (FR)
  2. WATER MILL (IRE)
  3. NIGHT CHAPERONE (IRE)

races.name: racingtv.com/freetrial - Last Day Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for most of these, but the vote goes to OUR PEGGY, who put her experience to good use to get off the mark in this sphere at Worcester last month and her new jockey has a good record when teaming up with this yard. Golden Falls has got better with each run in Britain, so she heads up the dangers on return, with Dancing Dame taken to fill out third.

  1. OUR PEGGY (IRE)
  2. GOLDEN FALLS (IRE)
  3. DANCING DAME (IRE)

races.name: Royal British Legion Poppy Appeal 2026 Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
GAMBIE TIEP is potentially thrown-in on old form so is well worth another chance after a considerate stable debut following a long absence. Likely front runner Applejack Poet is feared most.

  1. GAMBIE TIEP (FR)
  2. APPLEJACK POET (IRE)
  3. BELLE MONTROSE (IRE)

races.name: Get A Free Trial Of Racing TV Now Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Fairly useful bumper performer EUSTACE GRENIER is worth another chance over hurdles and may well add to Olly Murphy's fine course record. Scotto rates the most likely danger, with the potential of better to come from Claim The Throne.

  1. EUSTACE GRENIER (FR)
  2. SCOTTO (IRE)
  3. CLAIM THE THRONE (FR)

races.name: Jumps Looks Better On Racing TV Mares' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
CHOSEN HERO made a successful start over hurdles for the James Owen yard and could yet make her mark over fences. Gata Ban is a reliable sort for this level and should prove a stern opponent, whilst Sweet Nightingale isn't ruled out on the back of an encouraging comeback run.

  1. CHOSEN HERO (IRE)
  2. GATA BAN (IRE)
  3. SWEET NIGHTINGALE

races.name: Get A Free Trial At racingtv.com/freetrial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MR MACKAY showed he retains all his ability when runner-up on reappearance, and this looks a good opportunity to go one better. The next-best vote goes to Everyonesgame, who has less to prove than course winner King Jon Oliver.

  1. MR MACKAY (IRE)
  2. EVERYONESGAME (IRE)
  3. KING JON OLIVER (FR)

races.name: 31 Days Free Racing TV At racingtv.com/freetrial Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MR MCWHINNY had every chance of adding to his tally when departing at the last at Chepstow earlier this month so remains of firm interest. Chase debutant Painted Wolf may offer most resistance.

  1. MR MCWHINNY (IRE)
  2. PAINTED WOLF (IRE)
  3. HAWAII DU MESTIVEL (FR)

races.name: Sunday At The Races With Greendale EBF Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
OUR WEE HORSE made an encouraging start to his career when runner-up in a Fontwell juvenile hurdle last month and, having had excuses next time, he can build on his debut effort at the second attempt. The pair of newcomers in the line-up could be the main dangers, Naturaouse the pick for second ahead of Golden Dagger.

  1. OUR WEE HORSE (IRE)
  2. NATURAOUSE (FR)
  3. GOLDEN DAGGER

races.name: Elf Exeter Leukaemia Fund Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Runner-up on her completed start in points, Irish raider CORREEN wouldn't have to be anything out of the ordinary to play a lead role on hurdles debut and earns preference over Poet's Muse. Little Twig may have more to offer now her stamina is tested further following a break.

  1. CORREEN (IRE)
  2. POET'S MUSE (IRE)
  3. LITTLE TWIG (IRE)

races.name: Chris Down A Lifetime In Racing Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TORRENT made an impressive start over fences when scoring at Uttoxeter last week, going with plenty of enthusiasm in front, so he is taken to follow up with more still to offer. The biggest threat could come from Silver Hill, who wasn't seen to best effect on chasing debut, while Champagne Chic is interesting with his recent run behind him.

  1. TORRENT
  2. SILVER HILL (IRE)
  3. CHAMPAGNE CHIC (IRE)

races.name: Happy 70th David Clements Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MWABANI put his experience to good use when making a winning return in good style at Chepstow 6 weeks ago and with the prospect of more to come now handicapping, Jane Williams' charge makes plenty of appeal from an opening mark of 115. Treasure Planet would have finished closer but for a late error at Newbury latest and rates next best ahead of Wetherby scorer Washington.

  1. MWABANI (FR)
  2. TREASURE PLANET (IRE)
  3. WASHINGTON

races.name: Exminster Golf Club Supporting Elf Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Things couldn't be going much better for Jamie Snowden and his KEL DU LARGE gets the verdict to open his account over the larger obstacles with his reappearance under his belt. He Knows Better could be the one to give the selection most to think about on reappearance following a breathing operation, with recent winner Sage Green taken to edge out It's A Breeze for minor honours.

  1. KEL DU LARGE (FR)
  2. HE KNOWS BETTER (IRE)
  3. SAGE GREEN (IRE)

races.name: Exe containers.com 'Four Years Old' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MECENE has shown plenty of promise to date and can make a winning start in handicaps. One Island remains on a handy mark on his Flat form and isn't one to ignore, with the class-dropping Bandjo another to consider.

  1. MECENE (FR)
  2. ONE ISLAND (FR)
  3. BANDJO (FR)

races.name: Exminster Golf Centre Richard Candy Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The vote goes to ROMANY BROWN, who shaped as though ready to strike at Wetherby last time. The balance could tip toward Blue In The West if conditions become testing, with ground-versatile Locked Down Lad also considered.

  1. ROMANY BROWN (IRE)
  2. BLUE IN THE WEST (IRE)
  3. LOCKED DOWN LAD

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back 'Hands And Heels' Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty of pace on paper in this competitive 'hands and heels' event. ARANTES NASCIMENTO is narrowly preferred to Stenmark, with Lady Mariko feared if her 7-lb apprentice gets the best out of her.

  1. ARANTES NASCIMENTO
  2. STENMARK (IRE)
  3. LADY MARIKO

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ARKAT shaped with plenty of encouragement on debut, taking third late on in a Newmarket novice last month, and he can build on that effort to open his account. Representing a yard amongst the winners, he gets the vote ahead of Reign Over All, who should know more with his first run behind him, while Basics can also take a step forward.

  1. ARKAT (IRE)
  2. REIGN OVER ALL
  3. BASICS (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Those with experience set just an ordinary benchmark, so well-connected newcomers SEA FORTRESS and Lady's Mantle top the shortlist with the former preferred.

  1. SEA FORTRESS
  2. LADY'S MANTLE
  3. SHAREEK

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
OLYMPIC CHARTER knew enough to make a winning start at Nottingham back in the spring and with improvement on the cards, Charlie Appleby's gelding gets the nod to remain unbeaten. Maneuver's return didn't go to plan but remaining with potential, she can provide most resistance. Medaali is improving so he may prove best of the rest, though support for either of Saeed bin Suroor's newcomers would put a slightly different slant on things.

  1. OLYMPIC CHARTER (IRE)
  2. MANEUVER
  3. MEDAALI (IRE)

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The unexposed MERCI MONSIEUR opened his account on reappearance last time and can quickly double up now handicapping. Politely has worked her way back to form for her new yard and should go close again, while Duke's Command can't be ignored from his current mark.

  1. MERCI MONSIEUR (GER)
  2. POLITELY
  3. DUKE'S COMMAND

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
A competitive affair which can go the way of MARIA DA SILVA, who deserves credit for overcoming a pace bias at Kempton late last month. Eazy On The Eye backed up her Epsom win with a good effort at Newmarket and she should remain competitive from the same mark, whilst bottom-weight Cixi was better than the result at Kempton last time and also merits consideration.

  1. MARIA DA SILVA (IRE)
  2. EAZY ON THE EYE
  3. CIXI (USA)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
ONE FOR HARVEY is drawn widest but arrives in good form and can resume winning ways with her latest Southwell third looking strong form. Davorge Nation made a positive start for the Tony Carroll yard last time and is also shortlisted, whilst the balance of Little Jaybee's recent form suggests she can be competitive if over whatever seemed to ail her last time.

  1. ONE FOR HARVEY
  2. DAVORGE NATION (IRE)
  3. LITTLE JAYBEE

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
WELLWHATSHAPPENIN has made a positive start for current connections and ran well when second at Chelmsford 17 days ago, so he's taken to build on that effort here. Poke The Bear has bagged 3 wins at this track and is now 3 lb below his last winning mark so looks the biggest danger. Electric Bass is one of several others with place claims.

  1. WELLWHATSHAPPENIN (IRE)
  2. POKE THE BEAR (IRE)
  3. ELECTRIC BASS

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict:
AUTUMN'S BREEZE needs to brush up on her starts but a change in headgear may help on that score and she now finds herself back down in 0-65 company so could prove good enough in a trappy contest. Notable Charm has been shaping well and is one to take seriously up against older horses, while Chilli King is only just finding his feet and should improve further for the step up to 2m.

  1. AUTUMN'S BREEZE (IRE)
  2. NOTABLE CHARM
  3. CHILLI KING

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Academy Hurdle
races.verdict:
GREEN HERITAGE showed promise when third over 19f at Punchestown on debut and, open to improvement with the drop in trip likely to suit, is taken to get off the mark. Noon Blu Dodville is feared most after looking booked for second at worst when falling on debut whilst Wexford runner-up Hansel The Purse is also respected.

  1. GREEN HERITAGE (IRE)
  2. NOON BLU DODVILLE (FR)
  3. HANSEL THE PURSE (IRE)

races.name: Join Racing TV Now With A Free Trial Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
French bumper winner MAESTRO DES PINS showed ability on his debut here for Willie Mullins back in May and he makes most appeal ahead of Darby O'Gill, who was an expensive purchase from France for the Gordon Elliott yard after making the frame on 2 of his 3 starts for former connections. Henry de Bromhead's point winner Personal Space also merits consideration on Rules debut.

  1. MAESTRO DES PINS (FR)
  2. DARBY O'GILL (IRE)
  3. PERSONAL SPACE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
SOUL ASYLUM made a promising hurdling debut when third at Wexford 28 days ago and that run may well have been needed, so he's fancied to build on that and open his account over hurdles. Look Me is of obvious interest making hurdling debut for his top yard and could be the biggest threat, while Young Rebel has something to recommend too.

  1. SOUL ASYLUM (IRE)
  2. LOOK ME (FR)
  3. YOUNG REBEL (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
A strong race of its type, but PLACE DE LA NATION was the best of these over hurdles having won a Grade 1 at the Punchestown Festival on her final start and, likely to make a chaser, she holds obvious appeal. Echoing Silence may prove best of those with chasing experience, while the selection's stablemates Bambino Fever and Sainte Lucie also warrant respect on their chase bows.

  1. PLACE DE LA NATION (FR)
  2. ECHOING SILENCE (IRE)
  3. BAMBINO FEVER (IRE)

races.name: Kevin McManus Bookmaker Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
KARL DES TOURELLES wasn't scoring out of turn in this sphere when landing a Galway novice chase last time and remains well treated on his best hurdling form. He can follow up back in a handicap. Rockonliam is progressive and feared most, while both the unexposed On Your Way and consistent Watch The Weather are also respected.

  1. KARL DES TOURELLES (FR)
  2. ROCKONLIAM (IRE)
  3. ON YOUR WAY (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Irish EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
ROSIE'S WINGS may well have made a successful chasing debut had he not made a late mistake at Fairyhouse recently, so Ross O'Sullivan's 6-y-o earns the vote to go one better with improvement likely. Having finished runner-up on sole start in points, Kaiser de Chanay heads up the dangers on chasing bow back from 7 months off, with Some Song and Speculateur another couple worth considering, too.

  1. ROSIE'S WINGS (IRE)
  2. KAISER DE CHANAY (FR)
  3. SOME SONG (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LANZHOU has been going the right way since switched to handicaps, gaining a first success over hurdles last month before awarded the race on chasing debut, and he can continue his progress as he returns to hurdling. Theanniversary Man isn't taken lightly under a penalty, though, while River Vale could go well with his recent run behind him.

  1. LANZHOU (FR)
  2. THEANNIVERSARY MAN (IRE)
  3. RIVER VALE (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
COCK AND BULL stepped up on his previous hurdling efforts when justifying strong support at Thurles 3 days and, with the longer trip not expected to be an issue, he looks capable of defying a 7-lb penalty and notching up a quick-fire double. King Of The Greys is another that arrives on the back of an improved win and is feared most, while the similarly unexposed pair The Rebel Fox and Tiger Twins are also capable of being involved if taking the required steps forward.

  1. COCK AND BULL (IRE)
  2. KING OF THE GREYS (IRE)
  3. THE REBEL FOX (IRE)

races.name: Mike & Mat De Kock Racing Stables Maiden Juvenile Plate
races.verdict:
FLORAL PRINCESS is preferred before market clues in a maiden full of newcomers. Hot Fire is another to note, along with Divine Plan.

  1. FLORAL PRINCESS (SAF)
  2. HOT FIRE (SAF)
  3. DIVINE PLAN (SAF)

races.name: Pound Bloodstock Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
ROXBURY PARK isn't easy to look past. The Bidder could have the most to offer of the remainder, while Red Hot Guy looks best of the rest.

  1. ROXBURY PARK (SAF)
  2. THE BIDDER (SAF)
  3. RED HOT GUY (SAF)

races.name: Duncan Howells Racing Stables Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
FLEUR DELACOUR is the one to overcome. Runthruthejungle makes the shortlist, while Gezouten Haring also seems unlikely to be far away.

  1. FLEUR DELACOUR (SAF)
  2. RUNTHRUTHEJUNGLE (SAF)
  3. GEZOUTEN HARING (SAF)

races.name: Morar Incorporated Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
LE CONCIERGE can deliver. Eye On The Victory is another who could have a big say in proceedings, while Clever Kid is also in the running for some place money at least.

  1. LE CONCIERGE (SAF)
  2. EYE ON THE VICTORY (SAF)
  3. CLEVER KID (SAF)

races.name: SA Home Loans Mr 84 Handicap
races.verdict:
NAUTICAL FIRE looks set for a big run. Deonarie could have a hand in the finish, while Cardinal Chief is the other candidate for the three.

  1. NAUTICAL FIRE (SAF)
  2. DEONARIE (SAF)
  3. CARDINAL CHIEF (SAF)

races.name: Stuart Ferrie Racing Mr 84 Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
HIGH FIDELITY is promising and can win again. Luneluck is a big danger, while Lady Godiva is another with the potential to be on the premises.

  1. HIGH FIDELITY (SAF)
  2. LUNELUCK (SAF)
  3. LADY GODIVA (SAF)

races.name: Pound Bloodstock Middle Stakes
races.verdict:
OVATION STAR could be the way to go. Kalahari Roller is fancied to take a hand, while Masterofthedesert could well have a say too.

  1. OVATION STAR (SAF)
  2. KALAHARI ROLLER (SAF)
  3. MASTEROFTHEDESERT (SAF)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Bright Future Apprentice Foundation Stakes
races.verdict:
ABBEY'S WORLD can win again. Nothing Cooler is another that comes into the equation, while Rock Music may be the one for third.

  1. ABBEY'S WORLD (SAF)
  2. NOTHING COOLER (SAF)
  3. ROCK MUSIC (SAF)
